responsibility: Computes and maintains the dependence graph used by GCC’s RTL schedulers. It defines dependency objects and lists, builds and updates true/anti/output/control dependences from register, memory, call, and special hazards, provides iterators and debug dumping for dependence links, and includes logic for advanced dependency rewriting such as address-modification transformations that can break certain memory dependences. This file is the scheduler’s dependence-analysis backend, shared by Haifa, EBB, region, and selective scheduling.
